verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a built-in memory system that lets models remember facts, preferences and context across conversations, which covers durable cross-session recall. The only documented way to write memories is manual: users add, edit or delete them under Settings > Personalization > Memory. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the assistant writes memories automatically, detail on how recall is triggered, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the assistant remembers me across sessions — durable long-term memory it can write to and recall from automatically

citations.quote: Open WebUI includes a sophisticated memory system that allows models to remember facts, preferences, and context across different conversations.
The AI remembers facts about you across conversations
Users can manually add, edit, or delete memories by navigating to: Settings > Personalization > Memory
